taglines: Sunday. The week hasn't started yet but your future self is already disappointed in both of you.
It's a lazy Sunday morning. You're 'just browsing.' You now have a side project, a domain name, and a brand voice document.
Productivity tip: make a list. Look at the list. Feel bad about the list. Make a better list. The list is your legacy now.
Every system is a workaround for a previous system that was itself a workaround. Turtles all the way down. The turtles are tired.
The AI is confident. The AI is wrong. The AI is still confident. Somewhere in a data center, a number goes up.
You refactored it for 'clarity.' It is not clearer. You are not clearer. The function name is 'handleStuffV4' and that's on you.
Sunday brunch: avocado toast, iced coffee, 47 browser tabs, and the slowly dawning realization that 'MVP' was a lie you told yourself.
The bug only happens in production. The bug has always happened in production. Production is haunted and you built the house.
